info.name: Hospital & Doctor Management System API
info.description:
REST API for the Hospital & Doctor Management System.

Base URL: {{baseUrl}} — defaults to http://localhost:5000/api/v1 for local dev. Switch to the "Vercel Production" environment (or edit the baseUrl variable) when testing a deployed instance, e.g. https://your-project.vercel.app/api/v1.

**Response format** — every endpoint returns:
```
Success: { "success": true, "message": string, "data": {} }
Error:   { "success": false, "message": string, "errors": [] }
```

**Auth flow:**
1. Call Authentication > Register or Login to get `accessToken` + `refreshToken`.
2. This collection auto-saves both into collection variables via the test scripts on those two requests, so every other request's `Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}}` header works automatically.
3. When the access token expires (15 min default), call Authentication > Refresh Token — it also auto-saves the new pair.

**Deployment note:** the API runs as a single Vercel serverless function (`api/index.ts`), with every request rewritten through it — the URL paths themselves are unchanged, so this collection works identically against localhost or a Vercel deployment; just switch the environment.

**Implementation status:** Authentication is fully implemented against the current codebase. All other folders document the endpoint contracts as designed in the spec; check the project README for which modules are implemented vs. scaffolded.

item.name: Appointments
item.description: Booking, state transitions, and the double-booking-safe create endpoint.

request.description:
Books an appointment slot. This is the core concurrency-critical endpoint: internally wrapped in a Prisma transaction, and the database's unique constraint on (doctorId, appointmentDate, startTime) guarantees that if two patients race for the same slot, only one booking succeeds — the loser gets a 409, not corrupted data. Creates the appointment in PENDING_PAYMENT status and a linked Payment record; the appointment is only CONFIRMED once payment is verified (see Payments folder).

**Auth required:** Yes
**Role required:** PATIENT

**Business rules:**
- Doctor must be VERIFIED and ACTIVE
- Slot must be in the doctor's available slots for that date (schedule minus breaks/leave/holidays)
- Slot must not be in the past
- consultationFee is taken from the doctor's current fee server-side — never trust a client-supplied amount

request.description:
SSLCommerz redirects/POSTs here after a successful payment. The backend independently re-verifies the transaction with SSLCommerz's Validation API before trusting it — this callback alone is never sufficient to confirm payment, since it originates from the client's browser redirect, not a server-to-server channel. Duplicate calls for the same tranId are handled idempotently (safe to call more than once).

**Auth required:** No (gateway callback)
**Role required:** None

For production, the SSLCommerz IPN (server-to-server webhook) at `/payments/ipn` is the authoritative confirmation path; this success URL is for the user-facing redirect only.

Duplicate calls for the same tranId are handled idempotently (safe to call more than once).

**Auth required:** No (gateway callback)
**Role required:** None

**Role required:** ADMIN

- id: User id
